WES-06691x06695 Woodward II Single Cylinder Weslock Handlesets

text.description_html:
Weslock 06691x06695, Double Door Woodward II Handlesets

Weslock Woodward II Handleset is packaged as a complete set for a pair of Double Doors including one side with a Single Cylinder Function and the other Dummy Function. For the single cylinder, a thumb piece operates the latch and a key operates the deadbolt from the exterior; and the Utica lever operates the latch and a thumbturn operates the deadbolt from the interior. The Dummy Function does not function--neither locking nor latching. The Woodward II Double Door Handleset with Dummy is designed to fit doors 1-3/4 inches through 2 inches thick with backsets of either 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches. Satin nickel finish with the Utica Lever trim for these modern handlesets.

Features of the Single Cylinder Woodward II Entry Set:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Meets ANSI A 156.2 grade 2 lock standards.
  • 5-pin cylinder.
  • Adjustable latches with removable faceplates.
  • 1 inch throw deadbolt with two hardened steel rollers to prevent sawing.
  • Fits standard door preparations with 2-1/8" top and 2-1/8" bottom cross holes and 1" edge hole and a 5-1/2" center to center cross hole spacing.
  • Manufacturer Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • Manufacturer Limited 10 Year Finish Warranty

Specifications of the Weslock Woodward II Satin Nickel Double Door Handlesets:

  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Exterior Length: 18-3/4"
  • Exterior Width: 2-3/4"
  • Exterior Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Interior Length: 10-1/8"
  • Interior Width: 2-3/4"
  • Interior Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Interior Trim: Utica Lever
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" to 2"
  • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" with removable faceplates.
  • Handing: Reversible



** Item Discontinued See Door Handlesets
